name: Ring of Darkness
body:
Aura faint transmutation ; CL 5th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears and functions as a ring of shadows. Upon putting on the ring, the wearer becomes sensitive to light, suffering a -2 penalty to attack rolls, damage rolls and skill checks when in light brighter than dim light.

This ring can be removed by casting light followed by remove curse upon it, destroying the ring in the process.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of shadows

Identification DC 30
False Identification DC 20
